T3_about.h2: What MAGLUMI X10 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: MAGLUMI X10 is a fully automated Snibe CLIA analyzer for chemiluminescence immunoassay in medium and large laboratories. A single module can operate independently, or four modules can be combined for high testing volumes. Connectivity with total laboratory automation systems should be checked for the specific project.

items.text: Individual modules can be combined as the laboratory workload grows. Connectivity with total laboratory automation systems should be selected and confirmed for the specific project.
Area efficiency reaches up to 422 tests/h/m² within a single-module footprint of 2.4 m², according to the manufacturer.
The manufacturer states a 10 µL micro-pipetting volume with between-day precision below 1%. Different washing modes are provided for different assays.
RFID reading supports reagent loading. The interface allows operators to monitor the system in real time.

testMenu.title: MAGLUMI CLIA test menu
testMenu.text: The menu spans hormones, tumor markers, infectious and cardiac markers, and other areas. Ask LabWell to confirm which individual assays are available in Ukraine.

items.q: What is the throughput of MAGLUMI X10?
items.a: A single MAGLUMI X10 module delivers up to 1,000 tests per hour, while a four-module configuration delivers up to 4,000 tests per hour.

items.q: Which laboratories is MAGLUMI X10 designed for?
items.a: MAGLUMI X10 is designed for medium and large laboratories with high immunoassay workloads.

items.q: How many samples and reagents can be loaded?
items.a: A single module provides 300 sample positions and 50 reagent positions.

items.q: Which tests can MAGLUMI X10 perform?
items.a: The analyzer uses the MAGLUMI CLIA test menu; ask LabWell to confirm which individual assays are available in Ukraine.

items.q: Who supplies MAGLUMI X10 in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is a Snibe partner and supplier in Ukraine, providing supply, installation, staff training and service support.
